item.title: UK to permanently ban future generations from buying cigarettes
item.description:
📝 Upcoming generations in the UK will forever be banned from buying cigarettes under legislation that passed Parliament this week. Smoking itself will still be legal. But most indoor spaces already smoke-free will become vape-free, too.
🔗 Read more: https://nypost.com/2026/04/21/world-news/uk-to-permanently-ban-future-generations-from-buying-cigarettes/
